in_marathi.name: Awdesh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Awdesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Awdesh is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘avadh’ which means ‘worship’. The name signifies one who is devoted to God or a deity, and is used to honor and pay homage to the divine.
